# TotalFinance

> TotalFinance is a TypeScript financial-computation toolkit. The SDK covers options, strategies, technical analysis, portfolio P&L, valuation, risk, scenarios, and backtesting. The operation registry is a curated serializable subset, not universal SDK coverage. Compute uses caller-supplied data, not live quotes. Package versions below are workspace metadata, not evidence of npm publication.

- [Full API and operation catalog](llms-full.txt) — every public entrypoint, type-only export, and registered operation.
- [Operation catalog](llms-full.txt#operation-catalog) — full schemas, profiles, permissions, handles, costs, and SDK-only notes.

## Imports and bundles

For portable browser tree shaking, use named imports from `totalfinance/<domain>` or `@totalfinance/<domain>`, or supported feature subpaths. Root namespace re-exports are convenient but bundler-dependent. Installation size, final bundle size, and plain Node ESM loading are different; Node does no automatic dead-code elimination.

- [Imports and bundles](guides/imports-and-bundles.md) — namespace tradeoffs, facade services, type-only imports, and measured budgets.

## Scope and setup

23 default compute operations; 46 operations in the full registry. Read-only is the server default. Full/profile selection does not grant writes: required capabilities, writable stores, and explicit write configuration still apply.
Explicit packs are an exact selection, not additions to defaults. Check doctor and totalfinance://capabilities for the effective server, not this full catalog.
- [Agent setup, handles, errors, jobs, and safety](llms-full.txt#journey-connect-agent)
- [Assumptions and conventions](guides/assumptions.md)
- [Typed errors](guides/errors.md)
- [Technical indicators](guides/ta-indicators.md)
- [Warmup and lookahead](guides/ta-warmup.md)

## Packages

- @totalfinance/backtest @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 12 entrypoints. TotalFinance backtesting: a vectorized research engine and an event-driven execution simulator (broker, order types, margin/shorting, costs, corporate actions), walk-forward, tear sheets, and implementation-risk diagnostics. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/calendars @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 4 entrypoints. TotalFinance exchange calendars: rules-based NYSE, CBOE, and 24/7 crypto sessions. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/cli @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 1 entrypoints. TotalFinance local operations: file-backed artifact and job stores and the worker-terminated job runner behind the `totalfinance` command line.
- @totalfinance/commodities @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 3 entrypoints. Commodity carry and term structure: cost-of-carry forwards, implied carry inputs, roll yield, and curve analytics
- @totalfinance/core @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 4 entrypoints. TotalFinance core: types, conventions, errors, diagnostics, assumptions, and a zero-dependency schema facade.
- @totalfinance/crypto @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 5 entrypoints. TotalFinance crypto analytics: perpetual-swap funding, dated-futures basis, cash-and-carry, and the perp-vs-future no-arbitrage carry spread. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/fixed-income @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 15 entrypoints. TotalFinance fixed income: bonds (fixed/zero/FRN/amortizing/inflation) with full analytics, yield curves + bootstrapping, rates derivatives (FRA/swap/OIS/swaption/cap/floor), short-rate models (Vasicek/CIR/Hull-White), and credit (CDS, hazard/survival curves). Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/foreign-exchange @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 4 entrypoints. Foreign-exchange foundations: pairs, conversion, forwards, parity, and currency exposure
- @totalfinance/fundamentals @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 4 entrypoints. TotalFinance typed fundamentals: the point-in-time FundamentalPeriod contract, availability rule, and raw data-edge record. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/http @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 1 entrypoints. TotalFinance local HTTP server: loopback and read-only by default, with authenticated writes and registry-generated OpenAPI 3.1.
- @totalfinance/math @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 16 entrypoints. TotalFinance math: distributions, root solvers, optimizers, interpolation, linear algebra, integration, statistics, and Monte Carlo. Zero runtime dependencies, ESM, per-feature deep entrypoints.
- @totalfinance/mcp @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 1 entrypoints. TotalFinance MCP server: exposes the TotalFinance engine to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol. Read-only by default.
- @totalfinance/options @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 15 entrypoints. TotalFinance options: contracts, pricing engines, Greeks, and implied volatility. Browser-safe, zero runtime dependencies.
- @totalfinance/performance @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 12 entrypoints. TotalFinance performance metrics: returns, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar, drawdowns. Browser-safe, light imports.
- @totalfinance/portfolio @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 7 entrypoints. Durable portfolio management: the immutable economic-event ledger, pure event reduction, lots and multi-currency cash, valuation snapshots, and flow-aware performance inputs
- @totalfinance/research @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 5 entrypoints. Point-in-time research primitives: universe screening, cross-sectional style factors, and event studies
- @totalfinance/risk @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 8 entrypoints. TotalFinance risk & portfolio: VaR/CVaR (parametric, historical, Monte Carlo), portfolio risk decomposition, stress & scenario testing, factor/PCA exposure, and portfolio optimization (min-variance, max-Sharpe, mean-variance, risk parity, HRP, Kelly). Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/scenarios @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 2 entrypoints. Cross-domain scenario analysis with explicit targets, shared market state, full revaluation, Taylor attribution, reporting-currency aggregation, and durable replay
- @totalfinance/strategy @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 4 entrypoints. TotalFinance options strategy & profit calculator: payoff, breakevens, mark-to-market, Greeks. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/structure @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 3 entrypoints. TotalFinance options market structure: dealer-positioning estimates (GEX/DEX/vanna/charm), levels (walls, zero-gamma, max pain, pin risk), scenario maps, and options flow. All positioning is estimated and labeled.
- @totalfinance/technical-analysis @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 32 entrypoints. TotalFinance technical analysis: aligned indicators with serializable streaming state. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/valuation @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 4 entrypoints. TotalFinance valuation: time-value-of-money, NPV/IRR/MIRR cash-flow solvers, loans and amortization, capital budgeting and depreciation. Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/volatility @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 28 entrypoints. TotalFinance volatility: implied-vol surfaces, skew/smile metrics, IV rank/percentile, and event-volatility (expected move, probability ITM/touch). Browser-safe.
- @totalfinance/workflows @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 2 entrypoints. TotalFinance workflows: the protocol-neutral operation registry — one operation definition drives the SDK-facing runtime, the CLI, OpenAPI, and MCP. Read-only, provider-free, browser-safe.
- totalfinance @ 0.0.1 — pre-1.0 preview; 21 entrypoints. TotalFinance umbrella: one install, namespace re-exports of the whole browser-first quant toolkit (options, vol, TA, strategy, risk, structure, backtest, fixed-income, performance, calendars).
